name: NanoTIM Co. Ltd.
summary: NanoTIM Co. Ltd., established in 2016 and based in Daejeon, South Korea, specializes in offering thermal management solutions throughout the country. The company achieves this by utilizing a range of thermal interface materials, including silicone gap pads, silicone gap fillers, silicone thermal grease, and phase change material (PCM) with extrusion components.
